title: Evaluating eligibility criteria of oncology trials using real-world data and AI
summary: Emulating completed NSCLC trials on 61,094 patients showed many common exclusion criteria had minimal effect on hazard ratios; data-driven broadening more than doubled eligible patients on average and lowered hazard ratio by about 0.05.
ai_technology: Trial Pathfinder data-driven computational framework on real-world EHR data

source_review.scope: Europe PMC metadata and abstract only; Methods not read.

evidence.unknown: Observational real-world data; not a prospective trial.
evidence.ai_role: Data-driven algorithm selected criteria to broaden.
